messages.author: Michael Shokhen
messages.body:
Dear AMBER experts,
I would like to study the protocol described in the AMBER tutorial:
5.4 Loop Dynamics of the HIV-1 Integrase Core Domain
I am interested in the tutorial author name and the reference on
his original journal publication which is in the background of this tutorial.
Many thanks for your help,
Michel
*****************************
Michael Shokhen, PhD
Associate Professor
Department of Chemistry
Bar Ilan University,
Ramat Gan, 52900
Israel

messages.author: Maria Nagan
messages.body:
Hi-
This is kind of an older tutorial but the analysis approach might be helpful. This is a Matt Lee tutorial. Here’s the original publication:
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15731379/
Maria
